request.description: Native pixel art modular asset kit for a whimsical fantasy snowy mountain fortress mobile game. 128x128 transparent canvas, four separate objects arranged in a precise 2x2 grid with empty transparent gaps and whole silhouettes. TOP LEFT: one broad cohesive low blue-gray alpine rock formation, piled thick natural white snow across its upper planes, a few icicles, strong stepped silhouette, roughly 58 pixels wide and 50 tall. TOP RIGHT: one small weathered supply crate, brown wood with dark iron straps, snow cap, front and slight side face, about 43 pixels wide and 35 tall. BOTTOM LEFT: a broad low irregular snowbank drift on a narrow dark blue stone base, about 58 pixels wide and 25 tall. BOTTOM RIGHT: a small varied cluster of blue ice crystals protruding from snow and stone, one main shard and two shorter shards, roughly 35 pixels wide and 45 tall. Top-left illumination, chunky connected pixel clusters, hard edges, economical shading, dark #0a0d11 separations, muted cold blue rocks and warm subdued wood, crisp white and pale blue snow. Readable at native resolution. No gradients, no antialiasing, no microtexture, no background or floor plane, no scene, no UI, no characters or text. Individual reusable game props, charming professional fantasy pixel art.
